currentIssues.title: [S29.11] 提供完整 Spot 金融计划、逐资产预留与所需估值

criteria.text: AC1. Resolve and pin the selected source profile, provider-entitlement and technical-access evidence, supported purpose-specific route contract, and actual evidence intake/policy evaluation without a rights setter or automatic fallback. Keep user-attested local-use policy distinct; the approved Binance attestation can satisfy only its selected-source MARKET_DATA_USE check and cannot be labeled provider entitlement.
AC2. Exact symbol/account/Proposal terms drive all role/side/family arithmetic; account comparisons never substitute.
AC3. Pin current-estimate rounding, authorization and native-bound semantics, preserving explicit uncertainty and unsupported absolute guarantees.

AC4. Conditional BNB and received-asset branches retain honest current estimates where consumed, original units, net receipts and total-family sufficiency; proven zero-BNB fallback requires no unused conversion and never fabricates its inactive BNB amount.
AC5. Exact BASE/QUOTE/BNB holding coverage, first receipts, free/locked amounts and local claims are consumed once with complete binding/retirement.

AC6. Under the approved conditional-fee contract, a complete current owning plan may qualify review/Prepare subject to every independent gate; prefunded native principal and the selected branch's actually consumed outgoing fee claim produce one atomic account-scoped per-asset reservation vector. Prepare persists the reviewed fee branch and received-asset fallback allowance as settlement metadata, not an outgoing capacity claim. No hidden funding operation exists.

AC7. Real per-asset fills/fees settle once against the persisted branch and allowance; branch/asset mismatch, missing fee truth or excess debit freezes for reconciliation, while pending/unknown safeguards remain and only unused capacity is released after broker truth.
AC8. Rust/schema/TypeScript support actual asset/pair/path/purpose/timestamp/quality/cost and backward-compatible captured/reservation records.
AC9. Qualified genuine required valuation/fee routes preserve configurable base, explicit direction and all selected legs; identity and unavailable routes behave honestly without parity.

AC10. Real supported external producer responses reach a positive owning financial statement and the same monetary-risk/Prepare consumer under their supported source-use basis, including the approved Binance attestation path where applicable, without a seeded authority shortcut.
AC11. Material changes invalidate incompatible consent; fresh matching revalidation retains original approval expiry and independent immutable collection provenance without receipt-only loops.
AC12. Prepare/preflight enforce the actual authorization/funding boundary and reject changed or unavailable evidence without partial state or provider mutation.
AC13. Genuine public TDD plus positive/error/lifecycle/concurrency/settlement scenarios and actual current/captured/pre-arm responsive UI pass.

AC14. Paired normative contracts, complete checks, ordinary build/pin, serial independent reviews and frozen source/evidence/remote/tracker handoff pass; full parent/map/real/native/physical/release acceptance is not upgraded by this item alone.

AC15. The owning Spot INTENT_POLICY valuation is displayed in exact provider pair, original numeric tokens and denomination with provider/receipt times and available sizes/status in current, captured and pre-Arm views. Do not add other-currency conversion, historical FX, reciprocal or parity inference. RiskDecision/Prepare consume it only when its currency matches workspace base; otherwise a typed valuation-currency blocker leaves no owning amount, approval authority or reservation. Other purpose-bound FX routes and independent source-use gates remain; only the approved Binance MARKET_DATA_USE check may use the distinct local attestation.

criteria.text: Public Settings → typed IPC → Control Plane → saved-source projection round-trips the confirmation and remains compatible with an older projection lacking the optional field.
Attest/withdraw use current state-version CAS, make no provider request, and invalidate dependent Hot observations through source generation without silently reacquiring them.

Binding scope and jurisdiction/policy/terms validation are Control Plane-derived; unsupported, unknown, stale, prohibited, mismatched or withdrawn states refuse with typed diagnostics. Renderer cannot set rights or binding fields.

Only the selected ordinary Binance `MARKET_DATA_USE` check passes with `DATA_USE_USER_ATTESTED_LOCAL_ONLY` for a current matching attestation; missing/stale/mismatched returns UNAVAILABLE and a known prohibition rejects. Provider rights fields and quote `dataUseRights` remain UNVERIFIED; Alpaca and simulation behavior is unchanged.
Current and immutable captured RiskDecision/UI expose bounded user-attestation provenance while raw quote/book values remain absent from persistent history.
Raw and derived Binance market data cannot reach model/tool prompts, research, exports or other external consumers.

Public RED→GREEN tests cover positive and refusal paths, binding changes, terms/policy revision, withdrawal, source disconnect/configuration, CAS races, compatibility, and no-network behavior. Fake only external HTTP/vault/WS/clock producers. This slice does not claim full owning-plan Prepare acceptance.

Paired English/Chinese contract and implementation evidence are updated. Run the focused checks and required standard repository verification for this code change; report any environment-specific limitation precisely.
